recommendations.rationale: The single executed candidate raised holding_tip_speed_weight to 0.1 and terminal_tip_speed_weight to 0.01 and worsened terminal error (+0.0194 m), holding max error (+0.00708 m), holding max speed (+0.5509 m/s) and mean complete update time (+1.851 s) while losing official reach success; no measured physical or computational improvement supports adopting these or other weight values, so no control change should be made now.

Attribution of the sampled holding position/speed failure requires candidate per-sample motion and timing, earlier baseline sampled motion (0.01-0.29 s) and retained warm-plan/iteration traces, none of which are displayed or retained here; the projected-state checks are bounded-horizon approximations rather than full backend replays, so no parameter change or causal conclusion should follow until that coverage exists.

attribution.reason: The one executed candidate raised the two tip-speed weights (0.0 -> 0.1 and 0.0 -> 0.01) and worsened terminal error by +0.0194 m, holding max error by +0.00708 m, holding max speed by +0.5509 m/s and mean update time by +1.851 s while losing official reach success; on this sealed paired comparison the tested intervention is not beneficial. Shared controller/model errors need not cancel, so this certifies the tested configuration's outcome, not a general parametric law.

Two weights were changed simultaneously at magnitudes that were not shown to be equivalent, in a single execution, so neither weight's contribution is isolated; the tested increase removed official reach success and worsened every physical metric, which weakens the specific 'raise the tip-speed weights' remedy, but a single paired execution cannot exclude the underlying mechanism.

The baseline stops as User_Requested_Stop in 34 of 35 updates, and both runs carry 35 control updates with similar stop patterns yet different physical outcomes; truncated effective horizons or early feasible returns are consistent with this hypothesis but no retained record ties a specific stop decision to a specific holding-window sample.

All updates miss the 0.01 s deadline at ~17.3 s mean wall time, but scheduling is synchronous, so wall-clock overruns are computation signals and do not establish skipped or delayed simulated updates; the candidate ran slower still (delta +1.851 s) with the same 35 misses, providing no separation between miss count and physical outcome.

Displayed projected-state differences (2.573 rad/m curvature and 26.13 rad/(m*s) rate residuals) are large relative to the settling scales, but the recorded classification states these are recorded projected states rather than full backend-state error, so they cannot be converted into a backend tracking error or a causal statement.

Holding-window coverage is 6 selected rows (0.30-0.35 s), earlier sampled backend motion (0.01-0.29 s) was not read here, candidate per-sample motion and timing are not displayed, historical warm plans and iteration traces are not retained, and no counterfactual replay tool exists; no single cause of the sampled holding position/speed failure can be isolated.

facts.statement: Baseline (execution cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef): terminal world-tip error 0.007642608585867386 m is below the 0.01 m reach tolerance and official reach-only task success is recorded true, while joint reach-plus-holding passed and sampled settling passed are both false; reach-only success therefore does not imply settling success.

Baseline sampled final holding window covers 6 rows at 0.30-0.35 s: position error spans 0.007642608585867386-0.05813810428573256 m against the 0.01 m limit and tip speed spans 0.6351726092425104-1.5810152739742807 m/s against the 0.02 m/s limit; holding_position_passed and holding_speed_passed are both false.

The executed candidate improvement-9245a22c5ff5 changed two cost weights relative to the baseline replay: holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0 -> 0.1 and terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.0 -> 0.01 (design statement baseline_delta 0.01 on terminal_tip_speed_weight); both weights were recorded as 0.0 in the baseline recipe.

Candidate complete execution 5105b4ffc1c9468980a13d1bd288f787: terminal world-tip error 0.027092171705332548 m exceeds the 0.01 m tolerance (terminal reach failed, evaluation task_success false), maximum sampled error is 0.06521673847872775 m and terminal tip speed 0.5621564767997672 m/s; its sampled holding position and speed checks also failed.

Campaign comparison under frozen classification physical_pareto_worsening gives candidate-minus-baseline deltas: terminal_error_m +0.019449563119465163, holding_max_error_m +0.00707863419299519, holding_max_speed_m_s +0.5508761210416926, mean_complete_update_s +1.8510354342870414 and deadline_misses 0; no physical metric improved, so this is Pareto worsening rather than a trade-off.

Baseline computation: mean per-update wall 17.26331904856488 s against a 0.01 s control period with 35 deadline misses and stopping counts Solve_Succeeded 1 / User_Requested_Stop 34; the candidate mean complete update time exceeded baseline by 1.8510354342870414 s (19.114 vs 17.263 s), and both runs record 35 control updates, 0 solver failures and real_time_demonstrated false.

Both runs are recorded as complete and valid solver-error-free executions (complete true, valid_complete_execution true, 0 solver failures); the baseline's official reach-only success is true while the candidate's terminal reach fails, and the candidate fails both sampled holding checks.

Candidate drive utilization records the 8 N limit being reached on several tendons (near_t0, near_t1, near_t2, far_t0, far_t2 with near_upper_fraction 0.0286-0.0571) and near-zero or negative-zero tensions on some channels (minimum -0.0 on near_t2 and far_t0), whereas the baseline's largest applied tension is 7.990411884680996 N; this is a utilization observation only, not a causal claim.

Coverage and check boundaries: the holding-window summary is selected rows only, not whole-trajectory ranges; full_snapshots_available is false and historical warm plans/iteration traces are not reconstructed; recorded projected-state differences are explicitly 'recorded projected states, not full backend-state error', and displayed per-update values such as 2.5732817644233137 rad/m curvature residual (update 29) and 26.133878477389572 rad/(m*s) rate residual (update 33) show the plan-check state differs from the backend state without quantifying backend error.

No closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal-attribution capability is listed; numerical checks use a projected GVS state with bounded horizon and some horizon records are unsupported, and the recorded diagnostic limitation states that sampled observations do not identify a dominant cause.

limitations: Holding-window position and speed ranges cover 6 selected rows (0.30-0.35 s) only and are explicitly not whole-trajectory ranges; continuous-time settling is not guaranteed by sampling.

The candidate changed two weights at once in one complete execution, so neither weight's individual effect is identified; shared controller/model errors need not cancel and small differences do not establish input or causal equivalence.
No closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal-attribution capability exists, and plan checks use a projected GVS state with bounded horizon rather than a full backend replay.
Historical full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces are not retained, and candidate per-sample motion/timing was not displayed in this context.

recommended_actions: Defer any control-parameter change: the only executed candidate (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.1, terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.01) worsened terminal error, maximum sampled error, holding max speed and mean update time and lost official reach success, so adopting it is unsupported and no other value was tested.
Report reach-only status separately from joint reach-plus-holding status: the baseline passes official reach-only success while failing the sampled holding position and speed checks.

Treat the sampled holding position/speed failure as unexplained pending candidate per-sample motion, earlier baseline motion coverage (0.01-0.29 s) and retained warm-plan/iteration records; no further candidate or saved-state check is authorized in this phase.
